research_rationale:
Identity: Executive Order 12631 of March 18, 1988, Working Group on Financial Markets (53 FR 9421, March 22, 1988), read in full from the official Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12631.txt. It establishes the Working Group (Treasury Secretary as chairman, with the Federal Reserve Board, SEC and CFTC chairmen or their designees), directs it to identify and consider the issues raised by the studies of the financial-market events of October 19, 1987 and the actions to carry out the recommendations, to consult with market participants, and to report to the President initially within 60 days and periodically thereafter, and sets administrative support (section 3). The fourteen machine clauses cover the whole operative text without gaps and are confirmed without correction. Ending search: the order has no sunset, expiry date or terminating condition. The held corpus was searched for the number 12631 and the name of the Working Group: no instrument amends, revokes or supersedes the order. The later-events:ofr_catalog search has no hit for the order (no Office of the Federal Register disposition note names it as amended, revoked or superseded); the U.S. Code note under 15 U.S.C. 78b (release point 119-121, in the packet) prints the order as provided with no ending statement; the later held texts (Federal Register notice 2010-28177, the Presidential memorandum of June 4, 2020 published at 85 FR 35171, and Executive Order 14067 of March 9, 2022) refer to the Working Group as an existing body or to its prior work and do not alter the order. The one-time features are examined separately and do not end any clause: the 60-day initial report in section 2(c) was due 1988-05-17, a deadline and not an end, and the clause also imposes periodic reports without limit; the section 2(a) tasks carry no deadline and no held source shows they were completed or abandoned, so they are not recorded as ended. The June 4, 2020 memorandum directs the Secretary of the Treasury to convene the Working Group on investor risks, which shows the body in use after 1988, and it says nothing of ending it. Current predicate: the order is unrevoked and the U.S. Code note under 15 U.S.C. 78b still prints it. Bounded searches read against their coverage notes: current-law:usc (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09; laws enacted 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-14 are not reflected), current-law:ecfr (eCFR as of 2026-10-14 and GovInfo CFR bulk XML; no CFR hit for this order) and later-events:ofr_catalog (Office of the Federal Register disposition notes plus operative sentences in saved order texts; zero hits for this order). Limit disclosed: no held source shows the Working Group met or reported in 2025 or 2026; the claim rests on the absence of any ending instrument and on the order's own indefinite term.

The 60-day initial report date in section 2(c) is a deadline, not an end, and the periodic-report duty continues.","independent_command_check":"The section 2(a) tasks, the consultation duty, the reporting duty and the administrative-support duty are separate commands, each tested for its own end; the 60-day initial report is the only dated command and it sits inside a clause that also requires periodic reports without limit.","savings_check":"No saving clause and no ended clause, so no residual effect separate from the continuing clauses arises.","scope_check":"Fourteen clauses cover the whole operative text: section 1 (establishment) and its four membership paragraphs and the chairman paragraph (1(b)); section 2 lead-in with 2(a)(1) and 2(a)(2), 2(b) and 2(c); section 3(a), 3(b) and 3(c). Each continues; none is recorded as ended because no held source shows an ending, performance or extinguishment."}
